of MDEPC inspection and quality control.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Wear 
 your safety helmet, shoes and safety belt when cleaning insulators.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Transformer isolation and proper grounding is required.
There is a danger of falling into the oil containment pit when working near 
 large power transformers.
There is a danger of falling off the top of the transformer when cleaning 
 insulator, wear safety belt.
Disconnect supply of DC.
Before starting the 
cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer wear your breathing mask 
to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used 
in cleaning collect it and send it to the dump.
Fix any oil leaks to 
prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.
Oil leaks to the ground 
have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil and ground water and 
eventually on the ecosystem. "It takes only I liter of hydrocarbon spilled in an 
aquifer to render 1.000.000 liters of potable water useless for human 
consumption"
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool kit/set, including a torque wrench.
Safety Helmet, safety belt,
Voltage indicator, portable earth for discharging.
Blower or vacuum cleaner.
Oil Vessels
PVC Ladder - Brushes.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Work to be Carried Out
Carryout the
 Oil Analysis.
Check of silica gel & oil level of air breathers.
Check if there is foreign noise.
Inspect the control cabinet equipment.
